notes.title: Patch 0.8.5.1 Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,  

Patch 0.8.5.1 for [b]Lily's Labyrinth of Lust[/b] has just been released! 

This update brings some exciting new features, bug fixes, and performance improvements to enhance your experience.  

[hr][/hr]  
[h3][u][b]Patch Highlights[/b][/u][/h3]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Dynamic Difficulty:[/b] A new system to make gameplay more engaging and adapt to your playstyle.  
[*] [b]Low Graphics Mode:[/b] Optimized settings to ensure smoother performance on lower-end hardware.  
[*] [b]Front-End Optimizations:[/b] Smoother gameplay across the board for all players.  
[*] [b]Camera Fixes:[/b] Resolved bugs causing issues with camera movement and positioning.  
[*] [b]Alternate Skin Bug Fixes:[/b] Addressed color glitches related to the Nude Outfit.  
[/list]  
[h3][u][b]Back-End Improvements[/b][/u][/h3]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Material Pooling and Collision Optimization:[/b] Enhanced material performance for better visuals and stability.  
[*] [b]Liquid Cum Improvements:[/b] Enhanced collision, X-ray effects, and inside materials for a more immersive experience.  
[*] [b]Minor Material Fixes:[/b] Adjusted various material assignments for consistency.  
[*] [b]Improved MC Skin Tones:[/b] Polished the main character's skin tones for better visuals.  
[/list]  

[hr][/hr]  
[h3][u][b]How Can You Help?[/b][/u][/h3]  
We’d love for you to test the new build and share your thoughts! 

Feedback and suggestions from our players are vital for improving the game and delivering the best experience possible.  

Join the conversation and share your thoughts directly with the community and devs on our [url=https://discord.gg/QN8d8eSkUS]Discord server[/url].  

[hr][/hr]  
[h3][u][b]Closing Thoughts[/b][/u][/h3]  
Our team has been hard at work to bring both exciting new features and better optimization to Lily's Labyrinth of Lust. These updates aim to ensure the game runs smoothly, even for players on lower-end hardware, so more people can enjoy the experience.  

We truly value your input, so please continue to share your feedback and suggestions. Together, we’ll keep improving and expanding Lily's Labyrinth of Lust!  

Thank you for your continued support and for being part of our journey.  

- Erommersion Team
